column1: # Gold set: every cell of a real employee sheet, before and after ADR-035.
# FROZEN, and symmetric: the same cells are judged in both runs by the same
# rules, so the comparison means something.
# A verdict is only ever given where there is EVIDENCE:
#   untranslated       output is identical to the English input
#   leaked English     Latin in the output that was not in the source
#   means “...”        a mistranslation measured and back-translated in session
#   no Malayalam       nothing in the Malayalam block at all
#   a number...        the source carries no words, so identity is correct
#   refused            marked UNRESOLVED; excluded, it is not an answer
# Everything else is `unknown` and EXCLUDED from both metrics — including
# every transliteration. Whether തെക്കെവീട്ടിൽ is the right spelling of
# Thekkeveettil is not a thing a rule can settle, and an earlier draft of this
# file scored them `ok` by construction, which made the after-metric measure
# itself and report a perfect score. Those rows are what a Malayalam reader
